scenes.setting: The cold kitchen and a scrubbed iron pot: Hunter's blood, Jimsonweed juice, Dragon Tooth powder and three snake-like Naga hairs turning the brew deep blue, then the pituitary gland and the many-faced diamond — and a blackish-green potion that burps eye-sized bubbles reflecting faces

Behind a locked door: the potion melts face, bones and skin while Klein hauls his psyche back into his body two or three steps short of losing control — Sequence 6 at last, his skin crawling with pale granules until Cogitation smooths them away

Experiments at the full-length mirror: his own true face, Emlyn White complete with height and scent, Dunn Smith alive again, a magazine actress down to an unconvincing pair of A cups — and the limits of ten centimeters and skin-deep change. 'Good night, Faceless.'
